userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The read's overall or plate confidence is below the place's review threshold.
The engine reported no confidence for the read.
The jurisdiction requires a human to confirm a plate before enforcement.
The engine's alternate reads differ only in characters it commonly confuses (0/O, 1/I, 5/S, 8/B).
The read is about to be handed to an enforcement system that requires reviewed evidence.
Reads of the same passage (one captureGroup) disagree on the plate, country, or state/province.
